consent.title: Share Usage Statistics
consent.body1: WithGod collects anonymous app usage statistics (such as screen views and feature usage) to improve the service.
consent.body2: We never collect personally identifiable information like your name or email, or anything you share about your heart. You can use every feature without consenting, and you can change this anytime in Settings.
